title: Monthly client report
summary: A module's numbers are recorded for the canary client, the report is built as a dry run (nothing is stored), and, where the CRM accepts a prospect, the narrative is written and the report email is drafted behind an approval that reaches the Reviewer first. The last two steps may be skipped with the CRM's own reason: a first run calibrates them.

steps.title: Record a module's numbers for the report

bullets: Acceptance rehearsal: these numbers are made up.

steps.title: Build the report as a dry run
steps.note: A dry run stores nothing. If the CRM refuses a client that is not a customer, report that as the error: it is a finding, not something to work around.

steps.title: Write the report narrative

input.summary: Acceptance rehearsal for PiB Canary Co: this report goes to no real person and every number in it is made up for the test.

steps.note: Skip with the CRM's own reason when it refuses because no report was stored (the dry run stores none).

steps.title: Draft the report email: the approval reaches the Reviewer first
steps.note: Do NOT approve the approval it opens: the Cockpit checks where it went and cancels the canary's approval when the run ends. Skip with the CRM's own reason when it needs a stored report.
